tutorial.field: The field cards. Play a hand card of the same month (flower) to capture a matching field card. When two match, choose which to take.
tutorial.hand: Your hand. Select a card to capture a field card of the same month, then draw one card from the stock.
tutorial.info: Hachi-Hachi is a 3-player hanafuda capture game on the 48-card flower deck. When every hand is exhausted, captured piles are scored by card points (Bright 20 / Animal 10 / Ribbon 5 / Chaff 1) plus yaku bonuses, and each player settles against the 88 baseline. After the set number of rounds, the highest cumulative score wins.
tutorial.resetButton: Use the reset button to start a new game.
